observations: All six strict preference lists are visible on cards; receivers retain best offer.
Student proposals yielded Ann-X, Bea-Y, Cal-Z, with two student first choices and zero hospital first choices.
Hospital proposals yielded Ann-Y, Bea-Z, Cal-X, reversing first-choice counts to zero and two.

Both explicit stability checks reported zero of six unmatched pairs preferring one another; screenshot retained both results and current offer arrows. Reveal connects clashes, receiver choice, different outcomes and stability.
